notes: The opening *And when* is one rendering of the single waw (rule 55); the apodosis waw is then unrepresented under rule 14.
`הַקָּטֹן מִמֶּנּוּ` → *younger*: the comparative preposition and its suffix are left unrendered, on the reasoning rule 30 gives for `גָּדַל ... מִן` → *exceeded*.
`כָלֵב` is written as the English possessive and takes the phrase's determiner, so the article on `הַקָּטֹן` is `unrepresented` (rules 29, 41).
